subject: Handshake: ZenithGrid executive demo — CIO/VP attendance and recording preferences
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@zenithgrid.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@zenithgrid.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + executive demo request

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We ran the initial architecture review internally and our CIO (Mark) wants a short executive walkthrough focused on inference reliability and cost controls before we move forward. Ideally we’d have the CIO + one VP in attendance.

Can Redwood do a 30–40 minute session next week that clearly covers:
- expected latency at 99th pct for 2k token workloads
- batching/caching strategy and unit cost examples
- dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs for regulated workloads

We'd prefer the session to be recorded for our internal stakeholders, but Mark may request that recording be restricted to the executive team only (no wider org upload). Also attaching a quick doc with our top questions.

Potential times (PDT): Tue 8/10 10am–11am, Thu 8/12 2pm–3pm — Mark is flexible but prefers morning slots.

Attachments: zenith_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Product Ops, ZenithGrid
amy@zenithgrid.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@zenithgrid.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@zenithgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + executive demo request

Hi Amy / Mark —

Great to hear the CIO is interested. We can absolutely run a focused executive walkthrough and accommodate the recording restriction. Quick proposals:

Option A (recommended): 30 minutes live + 10 minute Q&A — short, tight narrative that hits your three bullets and a one-slide cost comparison.
Option B: 45 minutes live with 15 minutes deep-dive (ops/infra).

Available windows (PDT):
- Tue 8/10 10:00–10:40 (Option A) — Lauren (me) + Ben (SE) + Karthik (Customer Lead) available
- Thu 8/12 09:00–09:50 (Option B) — same attendees; if Mark needs VP instead of CTO we can swap Karthik for Senior AE

Recording: we can record and produce a time-limited link (expires after 30 days) and mark it private. We can also strip detailed runbook slides if you want a sanitized recording. Let us know preferred setting.

Attached is our demo deck and a one-pager SOC2 summary in case your security team wants an advance look.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | (650) 555-0134
Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pptx (pptx), SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@zenithgrid.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@zenithgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + executive demo request

Adding a couple of operational notes so Mark knows what to expect during the session: 

- We'll present a real traffic profile example and show 99th pct latency graphs for both hosted and dedicated runs.
- For the cost slide, I’ll include token-level math for the two quantization profiles you mentioned.
- If the CIO can’t make the live slot, we propose VP + Director live and then a 15-minute executive-only follow-up with Mark. That keeps momentum while still giving Mark a brief private touchpoint.

Also happy to run a 15-minute pre-brief with Mark off-calendar if he wants an embargoed run-through before we record.

Scheduling link (to pick exact slot): https://calendly.com/redwood/exec-brief-30

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Amy Chen <amy@zenithgrid.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@zenithgrid.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + executive demo request

Thanks Lauren/Ben —

We’ll take the Tue 8/10 10:00–10:40 slot (Option A) for the live exec walkthrough, and Mark will review the recording after the session with the request that access be limited to the exec team for 30 days. If we need a short private follow-up with Mark, I’ll book the 15-minute slot after the demo.

One ask on recordings/security: can Redwood provide an audit log entry showing who downloaded the recording and timestamps? Our InfoSec will want that metadata before we circulate internals.

I’ve shared the meeting invite to the exec calendar. Looking forward to the walkthrough — please include the cost slide and an apples-to-apples latency chart.

Best,
Amy Chen
Product Ops, ZenithGrid
